# VaultScaler

> VaultScaler builds Lev, an agentic engineering system for full SDLC automation. Founded in 2025, launching April 2026.

VaultScaler builds Lev, an agentic engineering system for full SDLC automation. The company's tagline is "Build More. Manage Less."

## Products

### Lev
Lev is an Agentic Engineering System that architects, builds, deploys, and supports software across the full SDLC. It uses a proprietary methodology called the Golden Spec — a living blueprint that captures every requirement, architectural decision, and reasoning before code is written. The Golden Spec progressively hardens over iterations, preventing the codebase from churning backward. Lev includes integrated SRE that has full context into specs, telemetry, and incident history. Pricing starts at $1,499 per project per month with a 14-day free trial. Lev uses a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model where customers provide their own LLM API keys.

- Product page: https://vaultscaler.com/lev/
- Differentiators: End-to-end SDLC ownership (not just code generation), Golden Spec methodology, integrated SRE, flat per-project pricing
- Target customers: Startup founders shipping their first products, enterprise engineering teams needing predictability and governance

### Radix Core (secondary product)
Radix Core is a GPU training optimization platform that uses closed-loop control to balance memory, compute, and power across training runs. It delivers up to 21% throughput improvement over standard FIFO scheduling (based on VaultScaler internal benchmarks). Deploys via Helm chart on Kubernetes 1.26+ with zero changes to existing training code or stack. Originally built for air-gapped deployment with zero egress. SLSA Level 3 attestations. Pricing is $45 per GPU per month with a 14-day free trial (up to 400 GPUs). Hyperscale pricing available for 1,000+ GPU deployments.

- Product page: https://vaultscaler.com/radix/core/
- Differentiators: Closed-loop multi-dimensional scheduling (memory + compute + power), air-gapped/zero-egress ready, SLSA Level 3, no stack changes required
- Target customers: ML/AI teams running GPU training clusters on Kubernetes

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is VaultScaler?
VaultScaler is the company behind Lev, an agentic engineering system for full SDLC automation. VaultScaler also builds Radix Core, a GPU training optimizer. Both products launch April 6, 2026.

### What is Lev?
Lev is an Agentic Engineering System that handles the full software development lifecycle — from architecture and spec creation through deployment and production support. It uses the Golden Spec methodology to prevent codebase churn and includes integrated SRE.

### How is Lev different from Cursor, Copilot, Kiro, or Devin?
Those tools generate code and stop. Lev owns the entire lifecycle from collaborative spec creation through deployment and production support, with integrated SRE that has full system context.

### What is Radix Core?
Radix Core is a GPU training optimization platform that uses closed-loop scheduling to improve training throughput by up to 21%. It deploys via Helm chart on Kubernetes with zero stack changes and supports air-gapped environments.

### What does Radix Core cost?
Radix Core costs $45 per GPU per month. A free 14-day trial is available for up to 400 GPUs. Custom pricing is available for deployments of 1,000+ GPUs.
